summary: Comprehensive frontend QA of all implemented CRs (CR-70 to CR-113) on MyGenie POS website. All 16 test items passed. Tested on desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px).

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — JSX requires camelCase prop name. The attribute still renders correctly in the DOM, but the warning indicates a non-standard prop usage.

action_items: LOW: Fix Hero.jsx EditableImage prop from fetchpriority='high' to fetchPriority='high' (React camelCase requirement) to eliminate console warning. Functionality works as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx uses fetchpriority (lowercase) instead of fetchPriority (camelCase) — React 18 warns about this in console but still renders the HTML attribute correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CRs 70-113 verified and passing. Key results: CR-70 (no Inter font) PASS, CR-71 (fetchpriority=high on hero img) PASS, CR-72 (lazy routes /pricing /blog /about /terms /privacy /solutions/restaurants /product/sell-serve) all PASS, CR-73 (petpooja footer phone+privacy) PASS, CR-74a sticky bar absent on petpooja PASS, CR-75 (H1 keyword) PASS, CR-76 (trust logos as img tags) PASS, CR-111 (meta title) PASS, CR-113 (QuickDemoSheet 4 fields + H1 text-3xl mobile) PASS, shortForm DemoForm (no years/city) PASS, /fine-dining redirect PASS, dataLayer page_view fires PASS, ConsentBanner visible PASS, no @import in index.css PASS.
